g.text: Isolation effects across starting populations — individual model
Each dot: one visitor history, averaged over all demographic repeats; incomplete histories are omitted and counted.
Diamonds: joint-survivor conditional means; bars: 95% history-bootstrap intervals. Violin widths show relative density.
Positive / negative values mean greater / smaller investment change under isolation. Identical scales in all panels.
